title: Microsoft Entra ID Application client secret: must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]
summary: Synthetic Microsoft Entra ID Application client secret values built to the documented format appear in 6 inputs in command lines, container and orchestration configuration, environment files, SDK and client configuration, source code, and command and tool output. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Synthetic value matches the pinned lexical format contract. Provider issuance, payload/checksum validity and liveness are not claimed.
